summary: Entrywise identity of matrices: both sides are products d_v⁻¹ x_v (g g')_v p⁻¹ regrouped.

steps.claim: Compare entries at each place v;
both sides are triple products of the rescaling d_v⁻¹, the point x_v, g_v, g'_v and the frame p⁻¹ (associativity),
which agree after unfolding adelicToInf, adelicEquiv and toRatCoords.
steps.lean: simp [adelicToInf, adelicEquiv, U.map, U.conj, Space.toRatCoords]; rfl
